headline: Access Bank Restructures Executive Leadership for African Growth
summary: Access Bank Plc has elevated Oluseyi Kumapayi to Deputy Managing Director for African Subsidiaries and appointed Olanrewaju Bamisebi as Executive Director.
why: Access Bank is one of Nigeria's largest financial services institutions, expanding commercial banking operations across sub-Saharan Africa.

impacts.name: Access Bank
impacts.why: Executive management changes aim to enhance regional banking operations and digital efficiency.
